title: Create attention anchoring system module chatbot/core/attention_anchor.py
description:
Create chatbot/core/attention_anchor.py to track and format active attention anchors, including unresolved questions, companion promises, and active user goals, for injection into prompt layers.

Before editing, inspect:
- chatbot/core/steps.py to see how context is currently compiled and passed.
acceptance_criteria: The system can track unresolved questions and active user goals and serialize them into context prompt format
